attempts.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: independently replaceable Ukraine Atlas game BODY sprite, compact v2 silhouette edit.
Input image 1 is the exact v1 edit target. Preserve its broad invented Ukrainian craft-inspired modern pixel-art style and palette; redesign the body's proportions and simplify the interior as requested below. This is new original artwork, not a stretched or cropped resampling of v1.
Output: requested square 1024 x 1024 PNG with genuine transparent alpha. One complete centered wingless body, north pointing straight UP, strict top-down view. Clear transparent margin on every side. No background, checkerboard pixels, text, logos, frame, ground shadow, montage or effects.
Compact framing: solid central BODY must occupy roughly 65–72% of total canvas width and 70–78% of total height, excluding any detached part. The body must have a broad solid mass readable at a 20-pixel square frame, aiming at least 12 pixels wide. Short nose and short tail, no long needle silhouette. Use a few large color regions and crisp stepped pixel clusters; remove fine inner ornament and hairline details.
Keep two small dark-edged shoulder sockets rooted directly into solid left and right upper body edges, with visible attached bases. NO extended wings, propellers, feathers spreading sideways, loose cables, detached ornaments, magic rings or moving parts. Procedural wings will attach separately.
Palette stays warm ivory #f3ecdf, deep indigo #29343c, muted turquoise #90b7bf, amber #e5ba6c and restrained coral #d98277, with the role's specified dominant colors. Broad outlines must read on both cream and dark backgrounds. No historical-authenticity claims or copied traditional symbols.
Requested edit: Replace the long slender falcon torso with a BROAD COBALT-INDIGO TRIANGULAR CHEVRON body. Wide angular shoulders and a short north-pointing chevron nose create a squat kite/arrowhead silhouette. Stubbier compact tail, no long hanging feathers. Dominant deep cobalt/indigo with ONE broad ivory V accent and restrained amber beak/eye marks. The blue triangular body must remain a solid continuous wide torso, not extended wings. No dense embroidery. Keep shoulder sockets directly rooted into the two solid upper flanks. Distinct from a round ivory swallow and a barrel-shaped spool.

Use case: background-extraction.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET, a game body sprite on an unwanted opaque gray-white checkerboard background.
Remove the entire checkerboard background, including all small checker pattern remnants and transparent-looking decoration outside the body. Return the complete centered subject as a PNG with a genuinely transparent alpha channel. Transparent means alpha=0 pixels outside the subject; do NOT draw a gray/white checkerboard, black background, white background or any other replacement pixels.
Keep the existing broad body silhouette, north heading, original colors, crisp pixel-art subject edges, short tail or bobbin, and its two attached shoulder sockets. No wings or effects. This edit changes the background only; do not narrow, redraw, crop, stretch or decorate the body. Keep the complete square framing and transparent margins.
One isolated sprite; no text, no logos, no border. Actual PNG transparency is required.
